# INXSocial

> INXSocial is an all-in-one browser-based social media management platform operated by INAXX LTD. It combines connected social accounts, post creation, single and bulk scheduling, a visual content calendar, media management, analytics and AI-assisted content creation in one workspace.

Canonical website: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/

## Public product pages
- Social media scheduler: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/social-media-scheduler.html
- Bulk social media scheduler: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/bulk-social-media-scheduler.html
- Social media content calendar: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/social-media-content-calendar.html
- Social media analytics: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/social-media-analytics.html
- AI Content Studio: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/ai-social-media-tools.html
- Pricing: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/pricing.html

## Product scope
INXSocial is designed as a complete social media management workspace rather than a scheduler alone. It brings connected accounts, post creation, reusable media, single-post scheduling, bulk scheduling, publishing status, a visual content calendar, analytics and AI-assisted creation into one system. Supported publishing and analytics capabilities vary by connected platform and by the permissions granted by that platform.

## AI Content Studio — available workflows
The current Plus AI Content Studio includes:
- Image Post: create a generated visual with caption, hashtags and alt text prepared alongside it.
- Carousel Post: create a coordinated multi-slide story with a shared caption and individual slide copy.
- Short Video / Reel: create short-form social video with captions and publishing copy.
- UGC Ad Post: create creator-style promotional content around a product, service or campaign brief.

The Short Video / Reel workflow currently offers two production routes:
- AI Generated Video: create original motion from a prompt or reference image using an AI video model.
- Stock Video Creator: create an edited story using professional stock footage with narration, music and captions.

AI-generated drafts and media can continue into the Posts workflow for destination selection and publishing or scheduling.

## Roadmap
AI Video Clipping is an upcoming feature and should not be described as generally available yet. The planned workflow is intended to help turn longer videos into reusable short-form social clips while keeping those clips connected to the same media library and publishing system.

## Indexing guidance
Public product facts should be taken from the canonical website and the public product/legal pages above. Private application, Studio, portal, administrator, OAuth callback and API routes are operational interfaces rather than public product documentation and should not be treated as indexable reference pages.
